task: Confirm the live Jev QC gate creates a distinct n8n execution for each submission and that those executions are retained in n8n execution history.
completion_requirements: Consecutive submissions to the gate return different n8n_execution_id values
Each of those executions is retained in the n8n instance's execution history

evidence.implementation: No code change. Submissions made with scripts/jev_qc.mjs (commit e9820b7) and one with curl to https://bwa357.app.n8n.cloud/webhook/jev-qc-central-gate on 2026-09-28.
evidence.tests: Six consecutive submissions returned n8n_execution_id 137, 138, 139, 140, 141, 142 in order, each with HTTP 200 and a qc_status field; no id repeated.
evidence.deployment: Not applicable: the n8n workflow was not modified.
evidence.verification: Distinct, monotonically increasing ids observed in the webhook responses. The n8n execution history UI/API was NOT inspected (no n8n credentials in this session), so retention is inferred from the incrementing ids only.
